name: HDEV Header Footer for Elementor
author: HendriDev

sections.description:
HDEV Header Footer for Elementor is a powerful and lightweight add-on that lets you replace your theme’s default header and footer with custom designs built entirely in Elementor.

Unlike other heavy alternatives, this plugin is strictly built to seamlessly integrate with Elementor’s modern Flexbox Container system and Atomic CSS Engine, ensuring pixel-perfect layouts and fast load times.

Features include:
* Create fully custom Header and Footer templates.
* Works seamlessly with Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface.
* Full support for Elementor Flexbox Containers and Atomic CSS generation.
* Built-in responsive Nav Menu widget with mobile off-canvas support.
* Extremely lightweight and optimized for performance.
* Conditional logic ready.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hdev-header-footer-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure that the Elementor plugin is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Plugins > Manage Templates (or your Custom Post Type menu) in your WordPress dashboard to start creating templates.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes! The plugin uses standard WordPress hooks to intercept and replace the default theme templates (get_header and get_footer), making it compatible with almost all modern WordPress themes.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No, this plugin works perfectly with the free version of Elementor!
